name: Question 16
problem:
Find ${lim}_{t\to 2}[f(t)\times g(t)]$ given that $f(t)$ and $g(t)$ are defined as

$$
\begin{aligned}f(t) & =⟨6-{t}^{3},\,{t}^{2}-6,\,\frac{16}{{t}^{3}}⟩, \\ g(t) & =⟨5-\operatorname{ln}⁡(3-t),\,\sqrt{6-t},\,2t⟩.\end{aligned}
$$
worked_solution:
First, we find the limit of each function:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{t\to 2}f(t) & =⟨{lim}_{t\to 2}\,(6-{t}^{3}),\,{lim}_{t\to 2}\,({t}^{2}-6),\,{lim}_{t\to 2}\frac{16}{{t}^{3}}⟩ \\  & =⟨6-{2}^{3},{2}^{2}-6,\frac{16}{{2}^{3}}⟩ \\  & =⟨-2,-2,2⟩ \\ {lim}_{t\to 2}g(t) & =⟨{lim}_{t\to 2}\,(5-\operatorname{ln}⁡(3-t)),\,{lim}_{t\to 2}\,\sqrt{6-t},\,{lim}_{t\to 2}\,2t⟩ \\  & =⟨5-\operatorname{ln}⁡(3-2),\sqrt{6-2},2(2)⟩ \\  & =⟨5,2,4⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we use properties of limits to calculate the final result:

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{t\to 2}[f(t)\times g(t)] & ={lim}_{t\to 2}f(t)\times {lim}_{t\to 2}g(t) \\  & =⟨-2,-2,2⟩\times ⟨5,2,4⟩ \\  & =|\begin{aligned}i & j & k \\ -2 & -2 & 2 \\ 5 & 2 & 4\end{aligned}| \\  & =|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 \\ 2 & 4\end{aligned}|i-|\begin{aligned}-2 & 2 \\ 5 & 4\end{aligned}|j+|\begin{aligned}-2 & -2 \\ 5 & 2\end{aligned}|k \\  & =((-2)\cdot 4-2\cdot 2)\,i-((-2)\cdot 4-5\cdot 2)\,j+((-2)\cdot 2-5\cdot (-2))\,k \\  & =-12\,i+18\,j+6\,k \\  & =⟨-12,18,6⟩\end{aligned}
$$

Find limt→2[f(t)×g(t)] given that f(t) and g(t) are defined as f(t)=⟨6−t3,t2−6,16t3⟩,g(t)=⟨5−ln⁡(3−t),6−t,2t⟩.

a
⟨−2,8,6⟩
b
⟨12,8,9⟩
c
⟨−12,18,6⟩
d
⟨−18,12,6⟩
e
⟨5,2,4⟩
Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

First, we find the limit of each function:

limt→2f(t)=⟨limt→2(6−t3),limt→2(t2−6),limt→216t3⟩=⟨6−23,22−6,1623⟩=⟨−2,−2,2⟩limt→2g(t)=⟨limt→2(5−ln⁡(3−t)),limt→26−t,limt→22t⟩=⟨5−ln⁡(3−2),6−2,2(2)⟩=⟨5,2,4⟩

Now, we use properties of limits to calculate the final result:

limt→2[f(t)×g(t)]=limt→2f(t)×limt→2g(t)=⟨−2,−2,2⟩×⟨5,2,4⟩=|ijk−2−22524|=|−2224|i−|−2254|j+|−2−252|k=((−2)⋅4−2⋅2)i−((−2)⋅4−5⋅2)j+((−2)⋅2−5⋅(−2))k=−12i+18j+6k=⟨−12,18,6⟩
